value.rationale: A canonical vertex-transitive cubic graph has 12,384 minimum contagious seeds whose completion times vary by four rounds; the entire natural optimum-size dynamical profile and extremal forest geometry are classified. The sharp contrast of disconnected fastest forests versus mostly single-tree slowest forests is mathematical structure beyond a scalar feedback-vertex optimum.
